principle: States describe epistemic status, not profitability or trading readiness.

PROPOSED.meaning: Autonomous proposition born with birth certificate; not yet tested by lifecycle experiment

UNDER_TEST.meaning: At least one experiment spawned from proposition's experiment_spec_draft; result pending or interpreting

SUPPORTED.meaning: Supporting evidence meets falsifiable_expectation without crossing disconfirm threshold; no unresolved contradiction

WEAKENED.meaning: Directionally consistent but below meaningful effect floor, high variance, or quality-limited support

CONFLICTED.meaning: Multiple valid evidence events point in opposing directions; proposition remains active but uncertain

FALSIFIED.meaning: Disconfirming_observation_spec threshold crossed or null_competing_explanation better supported

UNRESOLVED.meaning: Experiments run but non-informative; belief unchanged pending better test

ABANDONED.meaning: Explicit scientific decision to stop investigating; successful outcome when evidence warrants

excluded_states.READY_FOR_OOS: Discovery/challenger pipeline only — not proposition lifecycle

relationship_to_existing.PropositionRecord.EpistemicStatus: Subset at birth; lifecycle extends with UNDER_TEST, CONFLICTED, UNRESOLVED
relationship_to_existing.ScientificStatus: Separate discovery pipeline — do not merge enums
relationship_to_existing.NodeStatus: Graph node lifecycle — orthogonal to proposition epistemic state
